public_requirements: A body field declared restricted (brief.files_in_scope, assessment.test_evidence) yields captured evidence of kind restricted, which evidence packaging accepts.
Grade-context intake accepts evidence references of kind restricted, and their content reaches export with that kind.

Export withholds restricted evidence content with redaction reason restricted_content unless the redaction policy sets allow_restricted_content; an absent flag means false, and no other allowance releases it.
Requesting allow_restricted_content on POST /v1/exports/assay requires the raw export credential; a read credential gets 403.
